info.title: Stream API
info.description:
Governed campaign operations API. Every change to a live ad account goes through `POST /campaigns/{campaign}/changes` (`Idempotency-Key` required) and is approved before it is written. The `Demo sandbox` group is separate: it simulates Google Ads and Meta campaigns and never reaches a real account.

## Try it from this page
1. Open **Identity > Sign in and get an API token** in the left menu, press **Send API Request** with `{"email": "strategist@example.com", "password": "password"}` (approver and admin users exist too) and copy the `token` from the response.
2. Open the **Bearer Auth** section under Security on this page (or any endpoint's **Auth** field) and paste the token.
3. Open any group (Campaigns, Governed changes, Demo sandbox, Changelog, Administration), pick an endpoint and press **Send API Request**. Write endpoints need an `Idempotency-Key` header: any unique text, and reusing it with the same body returns the same result.

The base URL is `http://localhost:8000/api`. Money is integer cents; dates are ISO 8601.

post.description: Builds the structure the platform would hold (Google Ads: campaign, ad groups, keywords, responsive search ads; Meta: campaign, ad sets, targeting, ads) and 30 days of simulated metrics. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header: the same key with the same body returns the same campaign, a different body returns 422. This is a sandbox, so it is not subject to approval and never reaches a real account.

get.description: Includes the full platform structure and the daily metrics.

patch.description: Send only the fields to change (name, goal, status `active` or `paused`, daily budget in cents, vehicle, location, landing URL). The platform structure is rebuilt from the result; the external id and the metrics history are kept. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header; repeating the same change is safe. A sandbox campaign is not subject to approval and never reaches a real account.

delete.description: Removes the campaign and its metrics. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. Live campaigns cannot be deleted here: they change only through the governed write path.

post.description: The only way to change a live account. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header: repeating the same key with the same body returns the same change, a different body returns 422. The change is checked against live state, field locks, the emergency stop and the manufacturer rulebook, then waits for approval unless a pre-approved policy covers it.
